newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Five robbers die in shoot-out with Bogota police.
newsitem.headline: Five robbers die in shoot-out with Bogota police.

text.p: Five suspected robbers were killed in a shoot-out with police in northern Bogota on Tuesday afternoon, police sources said.
Three of the dead men were shot after they broke into a textile factory. The other two were killed about a block away as they tried to escape, police said. The firefight lasted about 15 minutes.
